texts.zh: 很显然[Root.GetName]曾经遭遇了一场灾难并留下了超量的辐射。但是原因尚不明确。随着在[Root.GetName]定居的殖民者不断增加，这个谜团开始越发让人烦恼。毕竟，如果连原因都不知道，我们又该怎么防止悲剧再次重演？
texts.en: While it's obvious that some past calamity released a vast amount of radiation on [Root.GetName], it's not obvious what caused it. This mystery is now bothering more and more of the colonists who have made [Root.GetName] their home. After all, if we don't know how this happened, what is to say it could not happen again?

texts.zh: 尽管[Root.GetName]上的大量辐射显然是过去的某起大灾难释放的，但我们仍未判明其具体原因，或者是否会再次发生这种现象。
texts.en: While it's obvious that some past calamity released a vast amount of radiation on [Root.GetName], we have yet to determine its cause or whether it is likely to happen again.

label.en: Let's get to the bottom of this!

texts.zh: 在彻底调查后，我们得出的结论是在遥远的古代[Root.GetName]上曾发生过灭绝事件。目前我们可以确定的是，当时[Root.GetName]上的本土居民已经快要发展为具有遨游太空能力的物种，但一个更加先进的物种突然闯入他们的恒星系，从轨道轰炸了[Root.GetName]然后再次离开，而少数幸存者也只能坐以待毙。
texts.en: After a thorough investigation, we have come to the conclusion that [Root.GetName] was the site of an ancient genocide. As far as we can determine, the native population of [Root.GetName] was on the verge of becoming a space-faring race when a far more advanced race suddenly entered the system, bombarded [Root.GetName] from orbit, and left again, leaving the few survivors doomed to extinction.

label.zh: 研究轰炸遗址，了解所使用武器的细节。
label.en: Study the impact sites for details of the weapons used.

texts.zh: 在彻底调查后，我们得出的结论是[Root.GetName]是某场被遗忘的战争的牺牲品。谁曾经住在这里，以及他们与谁交战已经不得而知，但很明显他们是在与来自星系外的袭击者们争夺这颗星球时被消灭的。尽管这个发现令人心寒，我们至少可以肯定这种事不太可能会再次发生。
texts.en: After a thorough investigation, we have come to the conclusion that [Root.GetName] was a casualty in some forgotten war. Who lived here and who they fought is unknown, but it is clear that they were wiped out following an extra-solar invasion force entering the system and the ensuing battle for the planet. While this is a chilling realization, we can at least be reasonably sure that it is unlikely to happen again.

label.en: Study what remains of the battlefields.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]的历史悲剧被揭开。很久以前，[Root.GetName]在两支相互竞争的强大势力之下艰难生存。到了某个时间节点，他们之间爆发了战争，战争愈演愈烈，直至[Root.GetName]上所有的高等生命由于核武器滥用而被全部毁灭。
texts.en: The tragic history of [Root.GetName] has been uncovered. Long ago, it seems that [Root.GetName] was dominated by two competing superpowers. At some point war broke out between them and the conflict escalated until all advanced life on [Root.GetName] was eliminated by excessive use of nuclear weapons.

texts.zh: 很久以前，[Root.GetName]似乎有两支互相竞争的强大势力。他们之间爆发了战争，而冲突不断加剧，直到[Root.GetName]上所有的高等生物都因滥用核能武器而被消灭了。
texts.en: Long ago, it seems that [Root.GetName] was dominated by two competing superpowers. At some point war broke out between them and the conflict escalated until all advanced life on [Root.GetName] was eliminated by excessive use of nuclear weapons.

label.zh: 究竟是什么导致他们到达如此的地步呢？
label.en: What could drive people to such a fate?

texts.zh: 尽管对[Root.GetName]历史进行了广泛调查，我们还是不知道这里曾经发生了什么。过去依然是一个谜。
texts.en: Despite extensive research into the history of [Root.GetName] we just don't know what happened here. The past remains a mystery.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]的当地生命体型庞大，远远超出了所能设想的生物体型极限。研究人员思索：“为什么它们这么大？对我们可有益处？”进一步详细研究原生生物的建议书蜂拥而至。
texts.en: The native life of [Root.GetName] is built on an epic scale, far larger than anyone previously thought was possible for biological life. The question now in the minds of our researchers is "What is their secret, and can we benefit from it?" Proposals to study the native life in greater detail are flooding in.

label.zh: 确保研究不会对它们造成伤害。
label.en: Ensure that the research does no harm.

label.zh: 研究它们？猎杀它们然后再看看有没有用处！
label.en: Study them? Harvest them and see if anything is useful!

texts.zh: 经过一段时期的调查研究，[Root.GetName]的科学家终于获得了突破并且成功实现了与一些巨兽的简单交流。尽管个头巨大，动作迟缓，并且难以沟通，泰坦巨兽们依然难以置信的坚韧和强壮。有一些表达了加入我们军团的意愿，他们毫无疑问会成为我们的杀手锏。
texts.en: After a period of research and study, the scientists on [Root.GetName] have managed to make a breakthrough and achieve limited communications with some of the Titans. While huge, slow, and difficult to talk to, the Titans are incredibly tough and strong. Some few have expressed a desire to join our military forces, where they will undoubtedly be an incredible asset.

texts.zh: 一场灾难性的连锁反应中，[Root.GetName]的科学家触怒了当地的泰坦巨兽。巨大的生物在殖民地肆虐，将他们前行道路上的一切都粉碎殆尽。
texts.en: In a disastrous series of events, the scientists on [Root.GetName] have enraged the indigenous Titanic Life. Huge creatures are rampaging across the colony, smashing everything in their path.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]不稳定的板块构造再次发生了剧烈变动。关于殖民地损失的报告刚刚送达。
texts.en: The unstable tectonic plates of [Root.GetName] have just violently shifted once again. Reports on the damage to the colony are just starting to arrive.

texts.zh: 近期发生在[Root.GetName]的地震在当地的殖民地造成了一个巨大的陷坑。无论那里曾经有什么，现如今都陷入地下的深渊了。
texts.en: The recent earthquake which shook our colony on [Root.GetName] has caused a large sinkhole to open. Whatever once occupied that spot is now deep underground.

texts.zh: 近期发生在[Root.GetName]的地震虽然撼动了我们的殖民地，但没有造成任何损伤。令人惊喜的是，这场地震反而让我们发现了一批有用的矿脉。
texts.en: The recent earthquake which rocked our colony on [Root.GetName] caused no damage and, serendipitously, has uncovered a batch of useful minerals.

texts.zh: 近期发生在[Root.GetName]的地震虽然撼动了我们的殖民地，但没有造成任何损伤。
texts.en: The recent earthquake which staggered our colony on [Root.GetName] caused no damage!

title.zh: 观测到彗星经过行星环带

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]的居民正在见证一出壮观的景象。一颗彗星正在经过[Root.GetName]的行星环带，效果被形容为“惊心动魄”。
texts.en: The population of [Root.GetName] are currently witnessing a spectacular sight. A comet is passing through [Root.GetName]'s asteroid belt and the effect is being described as "magnificent."

texts.zh: 毋庸置疑，[Root.GetName]大气中令人陶醉的效果让人无比享受，甚至在某些方面颇有助益，然而[Root.Owner.GetName]的保守派多次施加压力，要求清除这些可能产生依赖性的气体。
texts.en: While it cannot be denied that the intoxicating effects of [Root.GetName]'s atmosphere are enjoyable, and even helpful in some cases, there is pressure from the more conservative parts of the [Root.Owner.GetName] to crack down on the possibly addictive gases.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]大气中的致幻成分被全部清除了！
texts.en: The atmosphere of [Root.GetName] has been cleansed of its intoxicating elements!

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]大气经过过滤，致幻的效果已经大幅削弱。
texts.en: The atmosphere of [Root.GetName] has been filtered to greatly reduce the effects of the hallucinogen.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]周围的强力磁场最近在影响地面上的电脑。奇怪的是，这个影响并不是单纯地随机干扰，正相反，电脑实际上比预想中运行的更有效率了。这简直是老天相助……
texts.en: The Strong Magnetic Field around [Root.GetName] has been affecting computers on the surface recently. Oddly, this effect is not merely random interference, instead computers are actually working more efficiently than they should be. It's almost as if an outside force is lending a helping hand...

texts.zh: 环绕[Root.GetName]的强力磁场一直都在干扰着地表的电子仪器，但最近对我们的电脑造成的影响尤为严重。到目前为止我们仍不清楚事态的起因，不过我们猜测这应该是暂时性的。
texts.en: The Strong Magnetic Field around [Root.GetName] has always caused some problems with electronic instruments on the surface, but recently the effect on our computers has been especially notable. So far, it is unknown what has caused this flare up, although we suspect it to be temporary.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]是一台无比复杂而精细的自组织量子电脑。它的气候规律，当地生物，甚至我们的殖民地都被它当作神经元，整合进了星球大小的网络中。我们无法掌握其原理，也无法控制它，但如果我们以某种特定的方式来布置我们的电脑，[Root.GetName]将会增强其性能。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] is the site of a self-organizing quantum computer of astounding complexity and subtly. The patterns of the weather, the native life, even our own colony is incorporated into it and somehow used as neurons in a planet-sized network. We do not understand how this is possible, and we have no way of controlling it, but we do know that if we arrange our computers in a certain way [Root.GetName] will enhance their performance.

texts.zh: 尝试移除我们在[Root.GetName]上的致幻气体。
texts.en: Attempt to remove the hallucinogen from [Root.GetName]'s atmosphere.

texts.zh: 通过研究在[Root.GetName]上的泰坦巨兽，我们有望了解它们，甚至与它们进行交流。
texts.en: By studying the Titanic Life of [Root.GetName], we can hopefully learn to understand them and possibly even communicate.

texts.zh: 通过捕获在[Root.GetName]上的泰坦巨兽，我们将会研究出如何利用它们！
texts.en: By harvesting the Titanic Life of [Root.GetName], we should soon work out how best to exploit them!

texts.zh: 通过谨慎地监视[Root.GetName]上的泰坦巨兽，我们希望尽可能与它们和平共处。
texts.en: By carefully monitoring the Titanic Life of [Root.GetName], we hope to be able to coexist peacefully with them.

texts.zh: 数个奇怪的磁场干扰已经影响了[Root.GetName]上的生活。直到不久之前，磁场干扰的起因仍是个谜，但现在我们已经积累了足够的数据，应该可以揭露真相了。
texts.en: Several strange magnetic disturbances have unsettled life on [Root.GetName]. Until recently their cause was a complete mystery, but with the data gathered from repeated events it should now be possible to uncover the truth behind them.
